text:
incident-bot: PAGER: Prod /v1/generate elevated 5xx rate across us-west-2. Error spike started ~3617999000, current 5xx ~28% over baseline. Auto-alerting: latency > 95th, gateway 502/504, and model-runner crashes detected.

oncall-anna: on it. first check: is this routing-wide or specific model?

dmitri: Looks like model-runner processes (runner-v2) are segfaulting on long-context requests. I see repeated `SIGSEGV` and `OutOfMemoryError` in the runtime logs of pod inference-runner-7f8.

maria: Customer impact: error spike observed for tenants: acme-inc, payfast, and a few free-tier PLG signups. CS reporting degraded UX for chat flows.

alice: attaching relevant tail from node logs: ```
[2026-03-15T09:58:02Z] inference-runner[pid:4123] ERROR: segfault at 0x0 in kernel_quantize.c:0
[2026-03-15T09:58:02Z] kernel: Out of memory: Killed process 4123 (inference-runner) total-vm: 14000000kB, anon-rss: 12000000kB
[2026-03-15T09:58:03Z] gateway: 502 upstream prematurely closed connection
```

kevin: Confirmed pattern: OOM/segfaults during long sequences > 4096 tokens with quantized kernels. We ramped a quant kernel optimization yesterday; suspect regress.

oncall-anna: immediate mitigation options? runbook suggests: 1) route traffic away from affected nodes, 2) enable fallback model variant (non-quantized), 3) throttle large-seq requests, 4) scale up capacity.

dmitri: I'm starting a targeted drain of the three nodes showing highest crash counts and re-routing to fallback pool. Doing `kubectl cordon/evict` now.

maria: CS: I'll notify top impacted accounts (acme-inc & payfast) with ETA ~30-45m and escalation contact. Add note we are mitigating; they reported timeouts on critical endpoints.

alice: Rolling flag to disable the new quant kernel across us-west-2 is ready: `service/config: quant_kernel_enabled=false`. If we flip it, fallback to fp16 path should avoid the fault.

kevin: Warning: disabling quant kernel increases per-token cost by ~12% and latency ~5-10ms; but safe for availability. Recommend flip now.

oncall-anna: Approved — flip the flag in prod us-west-2. Alice, can you run the canary?

alice: Canary in progress on 10% traffic of us-west-2. Monitor crash rate + 5xx.

dmitri: Canary results after 3min: crash rate on canary nodes dropped to baseline, gateway 5xx on canary 1.8%. Rolling to 100% in 5 batches.

incident-bot: NOTE: automatic pager escalation will be paused for 15m during mitigation window.

akevin: I've also applied a temporary request-size limiter at the gateway: `max_sequence_length=4096` for user-level calls and `webrtc` flows. This will reject very large requests with 4xx instead of hitting runner OOM.

maria: CS update queued: initial message sent to impacted customers. Will also offer compensated quota if we miss SLAs.

oncall-anna: Observability: add a dashboard view for `runner.sigsegv.count`, `runner.oom.count`, and per-tenant 5xx. Put an alert threshold at >5 occurrences/min per pool.

dmitri: After full rollback of quant kernel, crash/oom rates in us-west-2 dropped from ~20/min to <1/min, 5xx down to ~1.5% cluster-wide. PGs still seeing a small elevated tail for large batch jobs.

alice: Patch plan: we'll revert the quant kernel change from yesterday and reopen a CI job to reproduce with long-context tests. Eng-runtime will own hotfix and a regression test for sequence >8k.

kevin: Also gating future quant kernel rollouts behind a staged canary that runs long-context synthetic load. Add that to the deployment checklist.

oncall-anna: Are there any lingering customer-impacting items?

maria: Payfast reports intermittent 504s for high-concurrency workflows; CS is monitoring.

dmitri: Mitigation for those: increase retry window at gateway by 1s and route those tenants preferentially to fresh capacity. I've put a transient route in place for payfast and acme-inc.

incident-bot: ACTION: Create incident P0 with postmortem owners eng-runtime (dmitri), product (maria), oncall (anna). Add link to incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/3618001111 (placeholder).

oncall-anna: Good catch and fast actions team. Keep me posted on any new crashes. We'll keep the incident channel open for handoff when primary oncall rotates.

customer-success-bot: Notified customers: acme-inc (OP-4321), payfast (OP-4322). Both ack'd and will hold for updates.

alice: Last note: we're scheduling a rollback + canary verification postmortem in the next 48h. Please add any logs to the incident doc.

oncall-anna: I'm handing off to night oncall at 3618030000. If we see >5 crashes/min or >3 tenants impacted, escalate to ENG runtime.

maria: Thanks — follow-up: postmortem will capture root cause, rollout cadence, and remediation (automated canary for long sequences).

incident-bot: RESOLVED: 5xx spike mitigated. Root cause under investigation. Severity: P1 -> monitoring.
